public_design_update: NESO South Cluster impact assessment selected Category D: reduced interconnection relative to the original HND; the three wind farms connect directly to shore via 1.44 GW lower-capacity cables, with a 2 GW Northern Cluster-to-Lincolnshire cable providing additional transfer capacity.
model_representation: Do not reproduce the original HND offshore mesh for these projects. A hybrid case must implement the approved Category D assets only once their terminals/routes/rating allocation are supplied.
blocking_detail: The outcome summary does not publish a complete asset register: number and endpoints of each cable; Birkhill/Lincolnshire terminal IDs; line/link parameters; losses; and in-service dates remain required.

public_design_update: SPEN's current proposal uses a new converter station next to Kilmarnock South and a switching station at Grangestone; it says this would allow the proposed 2 GW MachairWind project to connect.
model_representation: Use the current proposal as a status/topology constraint only; do not substitute a generic Kilmarnock-to-Pentir link.
blocking_detail: The wind-farm cable is illustrative and subject to consent; the page does not provide a complete circuit, terminal, loss or commissioning schedule.
